description: Pivot tables, a pivot designer, and Excel, PDF and CSV export for TanStack Table (v8 and v9) and shadcn/ui data tables. Works from the table instance the app already has; exports match the screen (groups as Excel outlines with SUBTOTAL formulas, filters, sort, pinned columns, formats).
rules: Install the engine with `npm install rowpine` and the UI with `npx shadcn add @rowpine/export-menu` and `npx shadcn add @rowpine/pivot` (or the full URLs https://rowpine.com/r/export-menu.json and https://rowpine.com/r/pivot.json).
Pass the TanStack table instance itself (from useReactTable in v8 or useTable in v9) to ExportMenu, exportXlsx, exportPdf or exportCsv; do not rebuild columns or rows for the export.
Per-column export settings go in columnDef.meta.rowpine: numFmt (Excel number format), format (PDF text), cellStyle, width, align, header, exclude.
Excel dates come from Date values; convert ISO strings to Date in the accessor.
CSV export is free. Excel, PDF and pivots need a license key set once with setLicenseKey(key) from 'rowpine'; without it they still run and the files carry a notice line.

For pivots use createPivot(data, config) from 'rowpine' or usePivot, PivotTable and PivotDesigner from the pivot registry item; export a pivot with exportXlsx(pivot.table, { rowStyle: pivotRowStyle }).
